P.name: Triumphant Roar
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Alistar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Triumph'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} he {{tip|stuns}} or {{tip|airborne|displaces}} with his {{tip|abilities}}, and each time a nearby enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} dies. He generates 7 stacks if a nearby enemy champion or epic monster dies.
P.description2: At 7 stacks, '''Alistar''' consumes them all to {{tip|heal}} himself for {{as|5% of his '''maximum''' health}} and nearby allied champions for {{as|7% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description3: ''Triumphant Roar'' can occur only once every few seconds, though '''Alistar''' may still generate stacks before then.

Q.name: Pulverize
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' smashes the ground beneath him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} simultaneously for 1 second.
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Standard cast time}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.15}}|Reduced cast time when buffered during Headbutt's dash}}}}

W.name: Headbutt
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location. If they are within 400 units upon arrival, he deals them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} {{tt|700 units|Reduced to 200 units if Pulverize was buffered during the dash}} over {{fd|0.5 seconds}} while also {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

E.name: Trample
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' tramples the ground around him every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 5 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Trample'' that lasts for the remaining duration, stacking up to 5 times.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70/10}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
E.description2: At 5 stacks, '''Alistar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against a {{tip|champion}} within 6 seconds ends ''Trample's'' effects to deal {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 275}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for 1 second.

R.name: Unbreakable Will
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Alistar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}}. For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage taken.
